lines.text: Carrying His own cross, Jesus goes to Golgotha, where they crucify Him with two others, one on each side.
Pilate posts a notice reading Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews, in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
The chief priests ask Pilate to change the sign, and Pilate agrees and rewrites it.

wrong_details.true: Pilate refuses, saying 'What I have written, I have written.'

lines.text: The soldiers divide His garments into three parts, then cast lots for the seamless tunic.

wrong_details.true: four parts, one for each soldier

lines.text: Jesus gives His mother to the disciple whom He loved, says He is thirsty, receives sour wine, says 'It is finished,' and yields up His spirit.
